rapport_notes: Recognized a 4-time repeat customer by name/history, empathetic on the price-increase pushback, proactively chased a loyalty discount.

evidence_quotes.agenda: what are your biggest concerns and what are the best, most important things you want answers to on this call today? / Customer initially said 'no concerns' but later raised a real one.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: '...it's a little sensitive, the washer and dryer, front loading...we need to make sure those are transported safely.' Rep asked about shipping bolts, explained the liability-waiver tradeoff, and offered a resolution — genuine multi-turn follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: keep in mind this is just an estimate. We are a time based company so you will be charged for the total time consumed by the end of the move.

top_strength: When the price increase since the customer's last move (April) surprised him, the rep proactively escalated to check for a loyalty discount rather than just defending the new rate — and still secured the booking while it was pending.
coaching_note: Communication (day-before call, named crew lead) still never made it into an otherwise strong call — add it to the standard closing perks recap.
